claim: first PLL-specific harness campaign -- proves xschem netlisting + sim/harness PVT-point substitution (process corner, supply, temperature) + ngspice execution run the four-block closed-loop PLL netlist (design/top/top.sch -- VCO + PFD/charge pump + loop filter + divider, issue #28) end-to-end against the sky130 PDK (issue #23). This is a plumbing claim, not a PLL performance claim: no spec/target-spec.md row is ratified yet (pending #1), and the .tran window (200 ns, two reference periods) is far short of a cold-start lock transient. The first recorded run (20260819-061455-f61b6d4) failed at every point during ngspice execution due to two now-fixed bugs: a pre-existing SPICE instance-naming defect in design/divider/divider_intN.sch (issue #44, fixed) and, once that was fixed, a missing sky130_fd_sc_hd stdcell .include in this testbench itself (issue #52, fixed). The current record (20260819-123508-fe0e6df) shows 17/27 points PASS; the remaining 10 fail either on this manifest's per-point simulation timeout or on an ngspice numeric-overflow error ('<value>, 2 out of range for ^') inside the loop filter's R1 resistor body-diode model (b.xxxtop.xxlf.xr1.brbody in the per-point logs) -- consistent with the open Icp/loop-filter/Kvco coordination gap documented in design/top/DESIGN.md driving VCTRL to bias extremes outside that model's well-conditioned range during this testbench's uncontrolled, unlocked 200 ns window, not a new testbench or harness defect. The netlist-patch-run-record loop itself is exercised correctly (this is the point of the plumbing claim).
methodology_note: this testbench's DUT is design/top/top.sch, the real four-block closed-loop PLL (not a throwaway circuit) -- straps NSEL[5:0]=011000 (N=25) and drives REF with a 10 MHz clock and RESETB with a power-on reset pwl, per sim/pll/testbench/tb_pll.sch's own header comment. The current record (20260819-123508-fe0e6df) shows 17/27 points PASS after fixing issue #44 (divider instance-naming) and issue #52 (this testbench's missing sky130_fd_sc_hd stdcell include); the remaining 10 points FAIL on this manifest's per-point simulation timeout or on an ngspice numeric-overflow error inside the loop filter's R1 body-diode model, both consistent with the open Icp/loop-filter/Kvco coordination gap (see design/top/DESIGN.md) rather than a new defect -- see the record's own Result table for the per-point detail. process_corners is the ratified rows 19/20 PVT grid (spec/target-spec.md, DR-003, #77) -- sky130's five standard MOS/BJT process corners including the two mixed-skew corners (sf, fs) that stress this design's un-cascoded PFD/charge-pump UP/DN current mirror -- not a bare local convention.
